sources.primary_title: Unifonic demonstrates how Agentic AI is redefining customer experiences at LEAP 2026
sources.verified_angle_summary: Unifonic is using LEAP 2026 to showcase its transition to "Agentic AI" for customer experience (CX). The company's platform aims to move beyond AI assistance to end-to-end execution of customer journeys while maintaining human control. A key highlight is "Agentic Marketing," an AI-powered solution for campaign execution. The announcement also highlights Unifonic's recent acquisition of Segmentify, which serves as the hyper-personalisation engine for these new agentic capabilities. The news was announced on August 31, 2026, and verified against Zawya and Arabian Reseller. A check of existing coverage files confirmed this angle has not been previously selected, making it a unique and material addition to the LEAP 2026 coverage.
